children: Today promises to be the busiest day for Q2 results, not just for this week, but also for the entire season. Over 90 companies are set to report numbers during the course of the day, along with the many others that will be reacting to their numbers that were reported after market hours on Wednesday. Bharti Airtel, ONGC, Mahindra & Mahindra, LIC, LG Electronics India, Titan, Britannia, Bharti Hexacom are some of the major results to be reported today, along with other broader market names like Aditya Birla Fashion, Glenmark, Berger Paints, BEML, Electronics Mart, Godfrey Phillips, IPCA Labs, Samvardhana Motherson, NBCC, NCC, Prestige Estates, Safari Industries, Shiprocket, Sonata Software, Tube Investments, Tonbo Imaging, VA Tech Wabag, VST Tillers are some of the many companies reporting numbers today. Among result reactions, BSE will be the most prominent one, followed by Lenskart, Dabur, Torrent Power, Nykaa, Premier Energies, Cummins India, Centum Electronics, NHPC, Orkla India, PI Industries, Tenneco Clean Air, and JM Financial, among others.
Watch this space for all the Live Q2 results update, management commentaries, brokerage views, and a lot more

title: Q2 Results Live Updates: Bharti Airtel, Titan, ONGC, LIC, M&M report today; BSE, PI, Lenskart react
